name: ILI爆贴核八冲
author: Iliary
description:
ILI爆贴核八冲

富一冷，抗低帧。此结构可以到十冲，但是无法富一冷。

所有逻辑均可去除：
系起冲和减少桥带缓存与分类器资源预警与停冲分析逻辑。

分类器指示对照：
 - 停冲原因
 - 预警
 - 安全
 - 水资源 低于45%水位
 - 钛资源 核心1k以内
 - 爆资源 核心800以内
 - 电力低 电力盈余不足20k
 - 帧率低 装卸运力过低

停冲后展示上次预警信息
正常运行时展示30秒前的预警信息
门是蜂鸣器:)

ILI Blast-Core Adjacent Eight-Impact

Cryo-positive by one mixer, low-FPS resistant.
This structure can be expanded to ten Impacts, but it will no longer remain cryo-positive.

All logic modules are removable:

* Impact startup logic
* Bridge-buffer reduction logic
* Sorter-based warning and shutdown analysis logic

Sorter indicator reference:
 - Shutdown reason
 - Warning
 - Safe
 - Low water resources (below 45% water level)
 - Low titanium resources (within 1k in core)
 - Low blast compound resources (within 800 in core)
 - Low power (less than 20k power surplus)
 - Low FPS / insufficient unload throughput

After shutdown, the last warning message is displayed.
During normal operation, warnings from 30 seconds ago are displayed.

The door is the buzzer :)
